test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language,'MFBTF' is written as 'LEASE' and 'UNISE' is written as 'TMHRD'. How will 'TRICK' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

The logic followed here is a subtraction pattern based on alphabetical positions.

'MFBTF' is written as 'LEASE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48dafe5b005153191570ae3c1dccf6f67040a31e40389ff65c0ebdebffe014fb.png] 

'UNISE' is written as 'TMHRD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea49b685a0a056931b55fa7e4893a56af27b5a6713a3b0e2abfadfbaacecc8c8.png] 

Now, let's apply the same logic to 'TRICK':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b327be09fe3c5d1529f9291bfa12ed4da5a290a2ee756d01748d08d12cbf0c2e.png] 

**'TRICK' will be written as 'SQHBJ'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
